newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: De Swann named to head Basle Committee.
newsitem.headline: De Swann named to head Basle Committee.

text.p: Tom de Swann, current director of banking supervision at the Dutch central bank, has offically been named to succeed Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa as chairman of the Basle Committee on Banking supervision, Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said.
Tietmeyer said that the Group of 10 (G10) central bank governors had appointed de Swann as chairman of the Basle committee effective April 10.
"We appointed him chairman of the Basle Committee on Banking Supervision and he will succeed Padoa-Schioppa from April 10," Tietmeyer said.
Padoa-Schioppa has served as chairman of the Basle Committee since 1993, but the Italian government recently appointed him as chairman of Consob, Italy's stock market regulator.
Tietmeyer was speaking to reporters after a regular meeting of the G10 central bankers here. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
